title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative (MSR)-Denver, CO (Metro)
description:
Job Description:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

title: Sr. Adv. Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

Reporting to the Quality Manager, works with occasional supervision and from broad guidelines and objectives. provides quality engineering services to cross-functional project teams which include New Product Development, Product Support, and Value Engineering. Project team members are led by a Project Leader and include Engineering, Marketing, Purchasing, Quality, and Manufacturing. Primary duties are to lead and direct the advanced quality and reliability activities of project teams to successfully meet Project Quality/Reliability Objectives as well as project goals including Supplier Development, Time-To-Market, Cost, and Performance. The primary duty of this position is to serve as a Quality & Reliability expert to the business and projects teams, with minimal supervision.  Should be able to demonstrate strong problem-solving & critical thinking skills and show proactiveness in executing deliverables.

Administration Responsibilities:

• Work with global teams in Asia and Mexico to execute NPD, Product Support, and Value Engineering projects.  Up to 20% travel is required.

• Serve as the representative to the Accessories Quality & Reliability team on NPD teams alongside Marketing and Engineering counterparts.  Effectively capture and communicate risk and lead alignment towards mitigation and closure.

• Research, develop and revise Quality Policies, Procedures, System Instructions, Engineering Standards and Work Instructions that govern the operations of the Quality Engineering Department and Quality-related activities of the Corporate Office and the Manufacturing Facility.

• Establish and maintain a framework and systems for collecting and analyzing product performance, statistical process control, conducting gauge repeatability and reproducibility studies.  Write standards and procedures governing the conduct of these activities including the data to be collected, reporting methods, etc.

• Formally lead and capture Supplier Development activities for all NPD projects to ensure stable processes and the manufacturing quality products in a mass production setting.

Quality Engineering Responsibilities (60%):

• Work with the global quality teams to develop QC mitigation strategies for high-risk specifications.

• Coordinate quality planning activities such as auditing, inspection, and control plans (incoming, in-process and outgoing) that drive user need CtQ requirements through product specifications and into manufacturing processes.

• Collaborate with US, European, and Asian-based manufacturing and supplier representatives to ensure operational readiness of new product launches.

• Ensure manufacturing process stability and capability through the use of advanced statistical methods; including Six Sigma methods, and Ppk and Cpk analysis and interpretation.

• Use advanced statistical analysis to recommend process improvements and value engineering ideas.

• Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers.

• Able to call, lead and conduct global, cross-functional team members with the following participants: New product development engineering, internal/external operations/suppliers, quality, and supply chain.

• Provide technical guidance to the PRC and US-based supplier quality teams.

• Identify and work on process improvement opportunities within the Quality/Reliability Department, beyond the core project teams.

• Monitor, investigate, and report field product reviews, utilizing various user feedback data streams to determine overall product health and assess risk of product quality.

Reliability Engineering Responsibilities (40%):

• Collaborate with Engineering and Marketing to translate customer needs into product requirements and specifications.

• Support the product design process including benchmarking and testing of concepts & prototypes.

• Develop and execute test procedures to validate product specifications and ensure Quality and Reliability readiness.

• Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle.

• Perform reliability analysis, using advanced statistical techniques including Weibull, ANOVA, and other statistical tools.

• Interpret and present advanced statistical data to a cross-functional team in a concise format.

• Perform failure analysis, and recommend solutions with corrective action, as required.

• Proactively seek out quality improvements for new and existing products.

Education and Experience Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent field, plus 5 years of related work experience

• Strong background in statistical analysis and methodologies

• Working knowledge of quality/reliability applications such as Minitab and ReliaSoft

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, specifically Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

• Nice to have experience:  Six Sigma, Auditing, Plant Quality, PowerBI, Test Development

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Project Engineer 1 - Value Engineering
description:
Job Description:

The Project Engineer I supports the cross-functional initiatives focused on cost reduction, product optimization, and continuous improvement for TTI Engineering. Working under the guidance of experienced project leaders and engineering leadership, this role helps translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, maintains project plans and risk visibility, coordinates technical deliverables, and supports products from concept through production. The Project Engineer I develops project leadership capability while building strong technical judgment, communication, and accountability.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Project Scope & Requirements

• Supports development and maintenance of product requirements, engineering specifications, and critical-to-quality (CTQ) measures for assigned projects.

• Helps identify where requirements create challenges to cost, performance, quality, or schedule.

• Supports product teardowns to drive new cost down ideas.

• Supports scoping of assigned systems, subsystems, and project deliverables with guidance from senior project leadership.

• Documents decisions, assumptions, open questions, and changes to project scope.

Schedule, Risk & Execution

• Develops and maintains work breakdown structures, action trackers, milestone plans, and project documentation for lower-complexity projects or defined workstreams.

• Tracks deliverables, identifies emerging schedule threats, and escalates issues when support or cross-functional alignment is needed.

• Supports project risk reviews by documenting likelihood, impact, mitigation actions, owners, and closure evidence.

• Coordinates prototype builds, testing, design reviews, pilot builds, and release activities with functional owners.

• Demonstrates consistent follow-through and personal accountability for assigned actions.

Cost, Quality & Product Performance

• Supports product cost tracking, competitive benchmarking, design trade-off analysis, and value engineering activities.

• Works with Design Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Compliance, Reliability, and suppliers to resolve project issues.

• Uses data from testing, builds, and supplier feedback to help the team evaluate options and make informed decisions.

• Supports compliance with internal standards and applicable UL, ANSI, CSA, and ISO expectations.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

• Facilitates routine project meetings or defined agenda sections with coaching; records decisions, owners, and due dates.

• Communicates project information clearly through written updates, presentations, and action summaries.

• Builds productive relationships with domestic and global team members and actively incorporates input from others.

• Proactively communicates obstacles and seeks help early enough to protect project commitments.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in engineering, product development, manufacturing, or project work; internships and co-op assignments count toward this requirement.

• Working knowledge of engineering fundamentals, drawings, product testing, and structured problem solving.

• Ability to organize technical information, maintain action trackers, and communicate clearly across functions.

• Strong analytical, planning, and follow-through skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, consumer products, or electromechanical systems.

• Familiarity with cost reduction strategies, DFMEA, CTQ development, and design verification.

• Fundamental knowledge of SolidWorks or other CAD software

• Experience supporting prototype or pilot builds and working with global suppliers.

• Basic proficiency with project scheduling, data analysis, and Microsoft Office tools.

Travel

• Up to 10% travel (international and domestic).

title: Design Engineer
description:
Job Description:

The Design Engineer I - Plastics supports the design, development, validation, and launch of injection molded plastic components and assemblies. This role is intended for an early-career engineer who can build foundational expertise across plastic part design, DFM/DFA, material selection, tooling considerations, molding processes, testing, and simulation-informed decision making.

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES

At Milwaukee Tool, our Engineering Teams develop innovative solutions that improve the productivity, safety, durability, and performance of products trusted by professional users every day.

As a Design Engineer I - Plastics, you will work within cross-functional product development teams to design and improve plastic components from early concept through production launch. The role provides hands-on exposure to plastic part design, materials, tooling, processing, manufacturing, testing, and injection molding simulation workflows.

This position is designed as a development role for an engineer interested in growing practical plastics expertise while contributing to high-impact product development work.

You'll Be DISRUPTIVE Through These Duties and Responsibilities

Product Design & Development

·       Design and develop plastic components and subassemblies for new product development and continuous improvement projects.

·       Create, maintain, and release 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

·       Apply DFM and DFA principles to improve product performance, manufacturability, quality, assembly efficiency, and cost.

·       Support design reviews, tolerance reviews, prototype builds, engineering builds, and production launch activities.

·       Collaborate with industrial design, product engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, quality, suppliers, and test teams throughout the product development process.

Plastics Engineering

·       Support material selection for thermoplastics, elastomers, and related polymer systems based on mechanical, cosmetic, environmental, regulatory, and manufacturing requirements.

• Understand and troubleshoot MCU peripherals and interfaces, including GPIO, timers, ADCs, and communication peripherals, while partnering closely with firmware engineers.

• Independently troubleshoot embedded hardware and system-level interactions, using hardware modifications and embedded firmware as needed to isolate root cause.

• Evaluate critical electronic components, perform technical tradeoff analyses, and recommend design or requirement changes based on performance, cost, risk, and project needs.

• Apply engineering best practices including circuit simulation, derating analysis, PCB design/layout, instrumentation, root-cause analysis, validation, and technical documentation.

• Own assigned deliverables against project schedules and work breakdown structures while proactively communicating technical risks, opportunities, recommendations, and required escalations.

• Collaborate effectively with hardware, firmware, systems, test, reliability, product-development teams, and external semiconductor/component suppliers.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field, with approximately 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience.

• Strong fundamentals in analog and digital circuit design.

• Hands-on experience designing, bringing up, testing, and troubleshooting MCU-based embedded hardware.

• Proficiency using laboratory instrumentation including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.

• Experience with schematic capture and the PCB design/layout process using ECAD tools.

• Experience applying circuit simulation and engineering analysis to guide and validate hardware designs.

• Working knowledge of MCU peripherals including GPIO, timers, ADCs, and serial communication interfaces.

• Demonstrated ability to systematically troubleshoot hardware and perform root-cause analysis.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Experience performing PCB rework and circuit modifications to support prototype bring-up, debugging, and design validation.

• Experience using embedded C/C++ to configure MCU peripherals and support hardware bring-up, test, and troubleshooting.

• Experience supporting EMC/EMI testing, troubleshooting results, and implementing design improvements.

• Experience with embedded communication interfaces such as UART, I²C, SPI, USB, or CAN.

• Experience evaluating and selecting MCUs, sensors, analog devices, communication ICs, or other semiconductor components.

title: Design Engineer 3
description:
Job Description:

Design Engineer III

The Design Engineer III is responsible for hands-on mechanical design execution for moderate to high complexity outdoor power equipment (OPE) systems and subsystems. This role owns detailed design execution from concept to production, with a strong emphasis on robust design, manufacturability, validation, and cost. Operating within the Outdoor Engineering organization, the Design Engineer III functions as a technical leader and subject matter expert for assigned components and assemblies, partnering closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and global suppliers to deliver competitive, production ready designs.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Technical Design Ownership

• Owns end‑to‑end mechanical design execution for assigned components, sub‑assemblies, or systems from concept, layout, and detailed CAD through validation and production release.

• Develops and maintains 3D CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, tolerance stacks, and specifications to ensure functional performance, regulatory compliance, durability, safety, and manufacturability.

• Ability to analyze problems and provide design trade‑off analyses (performance, cost, weight, manufacturability, reliability) and documents rationale for design decisions.

• Applies structured problem‑solving methods to resolve design issues, field failures, and manufacturing concerns.

• Demonstrates strong engineering judgment and accountability for design quality and performance.

• Design for Manufacturing, Cost, and Quality

• Designs components optimized for high‑volume manufacturing, assembly efficiency, tooling capability, and supplier process constraints.

• Partners with Sourcing and suppliers to evaluate manufacturing processes, tooling concepts, and cost drivers early in development.

• Ensures designs comply with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable UL / ANSI / CSA / ISO expectations.

• Verification & Validation

• Defines DFMEA inputs, design risks, and mitigation strategies for owned designs.

• Develops and executes design verification plans including tolerance validation, stress analysis, durability testing, environmental testing, and abuse testing.

• Uses data‑driven test results to refine designs and confirm requirements are met with appropriate margin.

• Reviews and approves engineering changes, deviation requests, and corrective actions related to owned designs.

• Cross‑Functional Collaboration

• Works closely with Product Management to translate customer needs and CTQs into clear engineering requirements.

• Supports Manufacturing Engineering during pilot builds, PPAP, and ramp‑up by resolving build issues and incorporating feedback into design revisions.

• Collaborates with Quality, Compliance, and Reliability teams to support certifications, audits, and failure investigations.

• Provides clear technical communication to global engineering, sourcing, and supplier teams.

• Contributes to the development and improvement of design standards, test methods, and engineering processes.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 4 years of design experience in consumer, industrial, or electromechanical products.

• Strong proficiency in 3D CAD (Creo / SolidWorks / NX or equivalent), detailed drawings, and GD&T.

• Demonstrated experience with materials, manufacturing processes, tooling, and supplier‑built components.

• Experience leading design verification and validation activities using data‑driven methods.

• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and technical communication skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, results‑driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, small engines, or high‑load electromechanical systems.

• Hands‑on experience supporting pilot builds and production ramp‑ups.

• Familiarity with global supplier collaboration and Asia‑based manufacturing.

• Experience supporting UL / CSA / ANSI compliance activities.

Travel

• Organize and align across product teams and commercial managers to develop a robust connected-product strategy and development roadmap.

• Drive communication with marketing, product teams, and platform engineering to capture the voice of the customer and translate it into connectivity features and user experiences.

• Create and manage robust project roadmaps and resource plans with converged scope; drive urgency in schedules and accountability for key project metrics.

• Champion firmware and hardware development processes (CI/CD, automated and hardware-in-the-loop testing, code review, requirements traceability, and release management) suited to connected products.

• Lead the development of test plans, procedures, and test cases for embedded systems and connectivity subsystems, including interoperability, field, and certification testing.

• Lead technology investigations, develop system requirements, and define future architectures and reusability strategies, including common connectivity stacks and shared building blocks across products and platforms.

• Maintain strong awareness of competitive offerings, emerging wireless/IoT standards, and the business climate to shape a best-in-class roadmap.

• Quickly, effectively, and candidly frame up and escalate business risks and opportunities to senior leadership.

• Identify new innovations and strategic opportunities, including edge intelligence/ML, while considering financial impact and competitiveness.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• 7+ years of highly successful embedded systems experience, including hands-on design and delivery of connected/IoT devices from concept to production.

• 3+ years of team leadership experience managing embedded firmware and/or electrical engineers.

• Demonstrated experience taking multiple embedded IoT products through development, certification, manufacturing launch, and field support.

• Expertise in C/C++ embedded programming and related development tools and processes, especially microcontroller peripherals, low-power design, and RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and/or embedded Linux.

• Deep knowledge of wireless connectivity technologies and stacks (BLE required; Wi-Fi, cellular, Thread/Matter, LoRa, or mesh a plus), including RF fundamentals, antenna design, and regulatory certification.

• Experience with IoT device-to-cloud architectures, including provisioning, OTA firmware updates, device management, and protocols such as MQTT or CoAP over TLS.

• Working knowledge of embedded security best practices (secure boot, encryption, key management, threat modeling).

• Understanding of digital circuits and the interaction between firmware and electronics; ability to realize component-level design.

• Practical knowledge of analog/digital system trade-offs and design, especially signal integrity, noise analysis, power management, and margin considerations.

• Familiarity with schematic capture, PCB layout software, SPICE, and industry best practices; experience with debug and test equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, RF spectrum analyzers, protocol sniffers).

• Experience with Agile/hybrid development practices, CI/CD, and automated testing for embedded systems is preferred.

· Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

· Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

· Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

· Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

· Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

· Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

· Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

title: Sr Regulatory Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and have an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Project teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis fabrics, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

Under the direction of Product Safety and Regulatory leadership, you will serve as a senior technical resource responsible for evaluating and managing product safety and regulatory compliance risks throughout the product lifecycle. You will lead hazard analysis activities, provide regulatory guidance to cross-functional teams, support global compliance strategies, and mentor developing engineers while ensuring products meet applicable safety, regulatory, and certification requirements.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Be able to evaluate information and render opinion as to the safety of a concept, design, or product.

• Serve as the technical product safety lead for assigned product categories, platforms, or complex programs, utilizing hazard-based analysis techniques to develop safety opinions and recommendations regarding the safety of product concepts, designs, and proposed changes.

• Advise Project Leaders, Engineers and Designers regarding safety requirements including tests and design constraints to minimize risk of injury and/or property damage.

• Communicate with external customers regarding product safety matters.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to incorporate relevant standards, regulations, and internal safety expectations into product safety analyses, and clearly communicate the requirements to technical and non-technical cross-functional stakeholders.

• Supervise product safety testing, including preparation of test sample(s), execution of the test(s), test reporting and data analysis.

• Resolve ambiguous or higher-risk safety questions by applying engineering judgment, standards knowledge, field experience, test evidence, and consultation with appropriate internal or external authorities.

• Incorporate lessons learned from post-sale safety feedback, field issues, claims, incidents, quality data, and corrective action activity into new product/project reviews.

• Mentor and onboard other engineers by coaching technical judgment, facilitation skills, documentation quality, escalation discipline, and cross-functional communication.

• Review and provide feedback for operator's manuals and on-product markings.

• Assist the Department Director in the execution of recalls.

• Be conversant with the latest OSHA requirements and industry safety standards, rules or regulations. Where requirements are unclear, assist in obtaining an interpretation from the appropriate authority.

The TOOLS you'll bring with you:

• Requires a Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Biomedical, or related field preferred) or technical equivalent.

• 5+ years of experience in product safety, regulatory compliance, certification, reliability, quality, design engineering, testing, or related technical risk assessment activities, preferably involving personal protective equipment (PPE), fall protection, power tools, lithium-ion batteries, charging systems, outdoor power equipment, accessories, or consumer products.

• Possess strong verbal, written and organizational skills essential to professional communication.

• Experience influencing cross-functional teams and communicating complex technical requirements to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Show an emphasis on and adherence to schedule and attention to detail.

• Ability to travel both domestically and internationally, as necessary.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food and coffee service.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

title: Customer Repairs Lead
description:
Job Description:

TTI Power Equipment is seeking a Customer Repairs Lead at its Anderson, SC location to support the Tool Repair Department. This hands-on warehousing leadership role trains and guides the material handling team in box opening, order entry, shipping, and battery processing while maintaining safe, consistent, and efficient daily execution. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including tuition assistance, 401(k), medical, dental, and vision coverage, vacation, and paid holidays.

Scope

The Customer Repairs Lead provides hands-on leadership and training for the material handling team that moves customer products into, through, and out of the repair operation. The Lead coordinates box opening and intake, accurate order entry, outbound shipping, and safe battery processing; establishes consistent standard work; and builds employee capability through onboarding, demonstration, coaching, and follow-up. The role may assist with inventory-related handoffs when needed, but its primary accountability is safe warehouse execution, employee readiness, material flow, quality, and turnaround performance.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead, train, and coordinate daily warehouse work for the material handling team across box opening, customer-product intake, order entry, shipping, and battery processing.

• Own onboarding and continuing training for material handlers through clear instruction, hands-on demonstration, documented standard work, observation, coaching, and follow-up verification.

• Assess employee readiness and skill gaps, provide refresher or cross-training, and partner with the Supervisor on development plans and qualification needs.

• Assign work and balance staffing to maintain safe, accurate, and timely warehouse flow into and out of repair operations.

• Ensure packages and products are opened, identified, documented, staged, and routed according to standard work while preventing damage or loss.

• Monitor order-entry accuracy and completeness, resolve routine issues, and escalate system, customer-information, or workflow concerns promptly.

• Coordinate outbound packaging and shipping to meet carrier, documentation, quality, and turnaround requirements.

• Oversee safe battery processing, including identification, inspection, charging, testing, segregation, storage, documentation, and escalation of nonconforming product.

• Reinforce warehouse safety, housekeeping, equipment-use, product-handling, and quality requirements through daily coaching and visible leadership.

• Provide day-to-day direction, reinforce expectations, offer timely feedback, and escalate performance, attendance, or employee concerns to the Supervisor.

• Confirm that employees have the supplies, tools, equipment, system access, and information required to perform their work safely and effectively.

• Track workload, throughput, training completion, order-entry accuracy, shipping performance, battery-processing quality, and operational constraints; communicate risks and recommended actions to supervision.

• Coordinate with inventory personnel when material handoffs, parts, supplies, or inventory transactions affect warehouse flow, without serving as the primary owner of inventory control.

• Experience with product intake, order entry, packaging, shipping systems, or customer-order processing preferred.

• Knowledge of safe battery handling, inspection, charging, testing, segregation, and storage practices preferred.

• Ability to explain standard work clearly, demonstrate tasks, evaluate understanding, and provide constructive follow-up.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to identify and communicate processing, system, equipment, safety, shipping, and quality concerns.

· Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

· Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

· Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

· Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

· Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

· Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

· Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC location for a Vice President of Consumer Insights & Intelligence. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Position Summary

TTI Consumer Power Tools is seeking a strategic, highly analytical, and consumer-obsessed Vice President of Consumer Insights & Intelligence to build and lead an enterprise-class consumer insights capability.

This executive will be responsible for developing a comprehensive understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitive landscape, cultural trends, retail environment, and evolving purchase behaviors—and translating those insights into actionable strategies that drive brand growth, product innovation, consumer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and revenue.

The VP will establish a unified Voice of the Consumer across the organization, integrating traditional research with behavioral, transactional, digital, social, retail, and first-party data to create a holistic understanding of the consumer. This leader will serve as a strategic partner to Brand Marketing, Product Development, Digital/E-commerce, Performance Marketing, Sales, Retail, Finance, and Executive Leadership.

The Mandate

The VP of Consumer Insights & Intelligence will ultimately answer three critical questions for TTI:

Who is our consumer?

What do they need next?

How do we use that knowledge to grow faster than the market?

Key Responsibilities

Consumer Insights Strategy

• Develop and lead TTI's Consumer Insights & Intelligence strategy across consumer brands, categories, and product platforms.

• Establish a comprehensive consumer understanding framework encompassing attitudes, behaviors, motivations, needs, purchase drivers, barriers, and emerging trends.

• Build a centralized Voice of the Consumer capability that informs strategic decisions across marketing, product development, innovation, retail, and customer experience.

• Identify emerging consumer behaviors and cultural shifts that represent new opportunities for TTI.

• Transform consumer research from a primarily reporting function into a proactive strategic growth capability.

Consumer Segmentation & Journey

• Develop actionable consumer segmentation models based on demographics, psychographics, behaviors, product ownership, category participation, purchase history, and lifetime value.

• Define priority consumer audiences and identify opportunities to acquire, retain, and grow high-value customer segments.

• Build comprehensive consumer journey maps from awareness and consideration through purchase, product adoption, repeat purchase, system expansion, advocacy, and loyalty.

• Identify critical moments that influence brand preference and purchasing decisions.

• Partner with marketing teams to activate consumer segments across paid, owned, earned, retail, CRM, and digital channels.

Brand & Marketing Intelligence

• Lead brand health and equity measurement, including awareness, consideration, preference, purchase intent, loyalty, advocacy, and competitive positioning.

• Develop measurement frameworks connecting consumer attitudes and marketing activity to business outcomes.

• Partner with Brand and Media teams to evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve creative, messaging, targeting, and media effectiveness.

• Lead consumer testing of brand positioning, creative platforms, communications, sponsorships, and major marketing initiatives.

• Establish competitive intelligence programs monitoring consumer perception, category dynamics, competitors, and market disruption.

Product Innovation & Consumer Validation

• Embed consumer insights throughout the product development process.

• Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, and Innovation teams to identify unmet consumer needs and emerging use cases.

• Develop consumer-led innovation frameworks that identify white-space opportunities for new products, categories, and services.

• Lead concept testing, product testing, pricing research, feature prioritization, and post-launch consumer evaluation.

• Ensure that product development decisions are grounded in meaningful end-user insights and market opportunity.

Data, Analytics & AI

• Integrate traditional research with first-party consumer data, CRM, e-commerce, retail, media, social listening, search behavior, customer service, product reviews, and third-party market intelligence.

• Partner with Data & Analytics teams to develop a unified view of the consumer across platforms and channels.

• Build predictive models to identify consumer demand, category opportunities, purchase propensity, churn risk, cross-sell opportunities, and lifetime value.

• Introduce AI-enabled consumer intelligence tools that accelerate research, identify emerging trends, analyze consumer sentiment, and uncover behavioral patterns.

• Develop executive dashboards that translate complex consumer data into clear, actionable business insights.

Retail & Shopper Insights

•
Build a robust understanding of how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products across physical retail, e-commerce, marketplaces, and direct digital environments.

•
Partner with Sales and Retail Marketing teams to understand shopper behavior and improve conversion.

•
Analyze retailer, category, promotional, pricing, and competitive data to identify growth opportunities.

•
Develop insights supporting assortment, merchandising, promotional strategy, product launches, and retail activation.

•
Connect consumer insights with shopper insights to understand the complete path to purchase.

Research Leadership

• Oversee TTI's portfolio of quantitative and qualitative research, including brand tracking, consumer segmentation, usage and attitude studies, concept and product testing, pricing research, creative testing, customer satisfaction/NPS, social listening, digital behavioral analysis, retail/shopper research, competitive intelligence, market sizing, and category forecasting.

• Continuously modernize research methodologies to improve the speed, quality, and business impact of consumer intelligence.

Executive Leadership & Organizational Influence

• Serve as the senior consumer advocate within TTI Consumer Power Tools.

• Translate complex research and data into clear strategic recommendations for executive leadership.

• Influence major decisions involving brand strategy, innovation, product portfolio, marketing investment, retail strategy, and long-term growth.

• Create a culture where major business decisions begin with a clear understanding of the consumer.

• Develop and lead a high-performing Consumer Insights & Intelligence organization.

• Build strong partnerships across Brand Marketing, Product, Sales, Digital, E-commerce, Media, Finance, IT/Data, and Executive Leadership.

Key Performance Indicators

• Brand awareness, consideration and preference

• Consumer acquisition and penetration

• Brand health and equity

• Customer retention and loyalty

• Net Promoter Score / advocacy

• Consumer lifetime value

• Product adoption and system expansion

• New-product success rates

• Marketing effectiveness and ROI

• Consumer segmentation activation

• Research speed-to-insight

• Forecast accuracy

• Retail/shopper conversion

• Revenue contribution from insight-driven initiatives

Qualifications

• 15+ years of progressive experience in Consumer Insights, Market Research, Consumer Strategy, Analytics, Brand Strategy, or related disciplines.

• 7+ years of senior leadership experience building and managing high-performing teams.

• Experience within consumer products, durable goods, home improvement, tools, outdoor products, automotive, technology, retail, or similarly complex consumer categories strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to translate consumer insights into measurable commercial growth.

• Deep expertise in quantitative and qualitative research methodologies.

• Strong understanding of first-party data, digital analytics, CRM, segmentation, attribution, social listening, and modern consumer-data ecosystems.

• Experience applying AI, predictive analytics, and advanced data science to consumer and marketing challenges.

• Experience working with major retailers and understanding omnichannel shopper behavior strongly preferred.

• Proven ability to influence C-suite executives and cross-functional senior leaders.

• Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex information into decisive business recommendations.

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA, advanced analytics, behavioral science, marketing, or related graduate degree preferred.

Leadership Profile

Consumer Obsessed — Constantly seeking to understand what consumers need, why they behave as they do, and where their needs are heading.

Commercially Minded — Connects consumer understanding directly to revenue, margin, market share, innovation, and enterprise value.

Strategic & Analytical — Combines rigorous analysis with strong business judgment.

Action Oriented — Moves beyond reporting what happened to recommending what TTI should do next.

Digitally Fluent — Understands the intersection of consumer behavior, technology, data, media, e-commerce, and retail.

Innovative — Embraces AI and emerging research methodologies to dramatically increase the speed and depth of consumer understanding.

Influential — Can challenge conventional thinking and build organizational alignment around the consumer.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

Reporting to a Manager of Quality / Reliability, the Quality Engineer's primary responsibility is to support the successful launch of new products by driving manufacturing quality readiness, risk visibility, issue management, and cross-site alignment throughout the NPD lifecycle. Working with increasing levels of independence, the QE collaborates with Design Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality, Operations, and global factory teams to identify manufacturing risks early, support readiness reviews, and help ensure quality concerns are effectively documented, communicated, and resolved.

The QE serves as a quality liaison between domestic new product development teams and global manufacturing organizations, helping to ensure that supplier readiness, process controls, fixture readiness, documentation robustness, and production readiness activities are completed with appropriate visibility and alignment. The role offers opportunities to influence new product development, improve launch quality performance, and drive continuous improvement across global manufacturing operations.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Support creation, maintenance, and communication of NPD project quality readiness status, risks, issues, and closure plans.

• Assist in maintaining project Quality Readiness tracking and ensuring manufacturing quality risks are documented and communicated throughout the project lifecycle.

• Participate in supplier risk reviews, manufacturing risk reviews, PFMEA reviews, control plan reviews, and production readiness activities.

• Support development and alignment of production test plans, fixture readiness plans, process controls, and manufacturing quality documentation.

• Help coordinate quality readiness activities between domestic teams and global factory Advanced Quality Engineering, SQE, AME, and Operations organizations.

• Track manufacturing, process, supplier, and quality issues identified during builds and support closure activities.

• Participate in Engineering Builds, Qualification Builds, and Production Readiness reviews and audits.

• Assist with execution and documentation of process audits, quality audits, and production readiness assessments.

• Support cross-site communication of lessons learned, process updates, PFMEA updates, PCP updates, and open quality concerns.

• Prepare project quality summaries, dashboards, status reports, and milestone review content for leadership and project teams.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement, quality system enhancements, and manufacturing risk reduction.

• Consistent global, onsite engagement critical to success.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, or equivalent education and experience.

• 1-3 years of experience in quality, manufacturing, reliability, operations, supplier quality, or related engineering disciplines.

• Understanding of quality systems, risk management tools, process controls, and structured problem-solving methodologies.

• Familiarity with PFMEA, Control Plans, Work Instructions, Process Audits, and Corrective Action systems preferred.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to effectively collaborate across multiple functions and global teams.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

• Experience with quality, manufacturing, or data-analysis tools is a plus.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 30%.

title: Operations Analyst - Distribution
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. has an exciting opportunity for an Operations Analyst within our Anderson, SC Distribution Center. This role serves as a strategic partner to Distribution, Transportation, Quality, and Business Operations teams by transforming operational data into actionable business insights.

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package including tuition assistance, 401(k), medical, dental, vision, paid vacation, and holidays.

Position Summary

The Operations Analyst supports distribution and warehousing operations across TTI Consumer Power Tool and Floorcare divisions by leveraging business intelligence, analytics, and process improvement methodologies. The successful candidate will collaborate with multiple functional areas to develop scalable reporting solutions, provide actionable insights, and identify opportunities that improve productivity, quality, and customer service.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Analytics

• Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical tools supporting distribution operations.

• Develop data models and reporting solutions that provide timely, accurate, and actionable business insights.

• Analyze operational trends, identify performance gaps, and provide recommendations to improve efficiency, cost, quality, and service levels.

• Create and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) related to distribution, warehousing, transportation, inventory accuracy, and quality performance.

• Utilize SQL, Power BI, Excel, and other analytical tools to support business decision-making.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with Distribution, Transportation, Quality, Business Operations, and Information Technology teams to develop data-driven solutions.

• Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable analytical solutions and reporting tools.

• Lead investigations into business-impacting issues and support root cause analysis activities.

• Present analytical findings and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders across multiple functional areas.

Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and reduce manual effort.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives through statistical analysis and operational performance reviews.

• Coordinate functional and technical process improvement projects.

• Support implementation and maintenance of analytical and technical solutions that enhance operational effectiveness.

Data Governance & Quality

• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting platforms and analytical solutions.

• Maintain documentation for reporting processes, business rules, data models, and analytical solutions.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to establish reporting standards and best practices.

Organizational Contributions

• Build credibility and trust by modeling professionalism, accountability, integrity, and collaboration.

• Contribute to long-term analytics strategy initiatives and business transformation efforts.

• Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

• Minimum two (2) years of experience in business analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, operational analytics, or a related technical role.

• Advanced experience developing and maintaining reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.

• Advanced SQL querying and data analysis skills.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, formulas, and data modeling.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management abilities.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with SAP data structures, reporting, and analytics.

• Experience with Python for automation, scripting, or data analysis.

• Experience working within Linux environments.

• Understanding of distribution, warehousing, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, and quality processes.

• Experience with data automation, ETL processes, or data warehousing concepts.

• Lean Six Sigma, Project Management, or business intelligence certifications.

• Experience supporting warehouse management systems (WMS) or supply chain analytics.

Work Environment

This role operates in a dynamic business environment that requires sound judgment, adaptability, and strong collaboration skills. The position regularly interfaces with stakeholders across various departments and organizational levels and requires the ability to influence decisions using data-driven insights. Strong communication, planning, organizational, and decision-making skills are essential for success.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in both office and distribution center environments.

• Occasional movement throughout warehouse and operational areas.

• Ability to remain seated for extended periods while analyzing data and developing reporting solutions.

• Ability to use a computer and standard office equipment for prolonged periods.

Note: The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Internal Candidate Qualifications

Internal applicants must:

• Have a minimum of six (6) months in their current position.

• Have no active final corrective actions.

• Have no more than six (6) attendance points.

• Have met established quality and productivity expectations during the previous three (3) month.

• Meet all minimum qualifications outlined in this position description.

title: Apparel Materials Developer II
description:
Job Description:

At Milwaukee Tool, Jobsite Apparel is built for the demands of professional trades. Our team develops performance-driven apparel by combining user insight, material innovation, technical development, and rigorous validation to solve real problems on the jobsite.

Your Role on Our Team:

We are looking for a Materials Developer who will help shape the future of Milwaukee Tool Jobsite Apparel by identifying, developing, testing, and commercializing innovative textile solutions across our apparel portfolio. This role will work at the intersection of material science, product design, technical development, sourcing, and manufacturing, translating product needs and jobsite challenges into materials that deliver measurable performance.

The ideal candidate brings strong textile knowledge, curiosity, and a hands-on development mindset. They will partner closely with Design, Technical Design, Product Management, Engineering, suppliers, mills, and testing laboratories to move materials from early exploration through validation and production.

This is an opportunity to do more than source fabrics. You will help build Milwaukee Tool’s material capabilities, influence future product platforms, and create differentiated solutions designed specifically for the professional trades.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Lead seasonal sourcing and development of all fabrics and trims, from concept through approval.

• Lead research and development of new fabric and trim concepts and technologies, proactively proposing solutions aligned to user needs, trends, and business priorities.

• Translate insights from trade shows, supplier visits, market research, and design briefs into clear material sourcing recommendations for cross-functional partners.

• Maintain complete and accurate material data in product lifecycle management (PLM) software, including quality, pricing, color, minimum order quantities (MOQs), and lead times.

• Own fabric and trim testing standards and test plans, ensuring alignment with product performance and compliance requirements.

• Manage all supplier, third-party, and in-house laboratory testing, including submits, tracking, and follow-up.

• Compile, analyze, and communicate test performance results, escalating risks and driving resolution.

description:
Job Description:

As an Advanced Quality Engineer for Milwaukee Tool, you will be located at our Corporate & Global Design Headquarters in Brookfield, WI reporting to the Quality Manager. Throughout a product’s development cycle, this position requires cross-functional communication skills and analytical expertise to help launch new and exciting solutions that meet user needs.  You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team.

Reporting to the Quality Manager provides quality engineering services to cross-functional project teams which include New Product Development, Product Support, and Value Engineering. Primary duties are to lead and direct the advanced quality and reliability activities of project teams to successfully meet Project Quality/Reliability Objectives as well as project goals including Supplier Development, Time-To-Market, Cost, and Performance. Should be able to demonstrate strong problem-solving & critical thinking skills and show proactiveness in executing deliverables.

Quality Engineering Responsibilities (60%):

• Work with the global quality teams to develop QC mitigation strategies for high-risk specifications.

• Coordinate quality planning activities such as auditing, inspection, and control plans (incoming, in-process and outgoing) that drive user need CtQ requirements through product specifications and into manufacturing processes.

• Collaborate with US, European, and Asian-based manufacturing and supplier representatives to ensure operational readiness of new product launches

• Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers.

• Able to call, lead and conduct global, cross-functional team members with the following participants: New product development engineering, internal/external operations/suppliers, quality, and supply chain.

• Provide technical guidance to the PRC and US-based supplier quality teams.

• Monitor, investigate, and report field product reviews, utilizing various user feedback data streams to determine overall product health and assess risk of product quality.

Reliability Engineering Responsibilities (40%):

• Collaborate with Engineering and Marketing to translate customer needs into product requirements and specifications.

• Support the product design process including benchmarking and testing of concepts & prototypes.

• Develop and execute test procedures to validate product specifications and ensure Quality and Reliability readiness.

• Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle.

• Perform reliability analysis, using advanced statistical techniques including Weibull, Minitab, and other statistical tools.

• Interpret and present advanced statistical data to a cross-functional team in a concise format.

• Perform failure analysis, and recommend solutions with corrective action, as required.

• Proactively seek out quality improvements for new and existing products.

Education and Experience Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• Previous experience with Advanced Quality, Quality Engineering and/or Reliability Engineering concepts

• Extremely critical thinker, able to evaluate and identify risks in the early product development cycle and able drive projects to mitigate those risks.

• Experience in manufacturing environments is highly preferred.

• Ability to travel 20% of the time.

Portfolio-Level Project Strategy

• Follow standardized work instructions and operating procedures.

• Maintain work area, including but not limited to, mold storage, secondary equipment storage and mold crib, per 6s facility standards without direction to reduce scrap and improve manufacturing efficiency.

• Proactively work with team members to meet the needs of the production floor.

• Ability to work overtime with advanced or little notice.

• All other duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• High School Diploma or GED

• Moderate proficiency to read and communicate in English

• 2+ years of specified Molding Technician experience

• 2+ years of quality and/or troubleshooting experience in a Molding environment

• Knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics, robotics, and electronics.

title: Director - Growth Leader for Brand Marketing
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC location for a Growth Leader (Director level). We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Position Summary

The Growth Leader manages initiatives that drive consumer acquisition, conversion, retention, and customer lifetime value. This role connects brand marketing, demand generation, digital engagement, and commerce to turn consumer interest into measurable business growth.

Working closely with brand, performance advertising, creative, consumer insights, analytics, and sales teams, the Growth Leader identifies opportunities to acquire new consumers, increase purchase frequency, and deepen engagement across the product ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

• Growth planning: Develop and execute growth plans aligned with revenue goals, consumer priorities, product launches, and seasonal opportunities.

• Consumer acquisition: Partner with advertising, content, affiliate, and retail teams to attract new consumers and generate qualified demand.

• Consumer segmentation: Use consumer insights, purchase behavior, and first-party data to identify priority audiences and tailor growth initiatives.

• Conversion optimization: Identify friction across websites, landing pages, product pages, and retailer purchase journeys; coordinate improvements that increase conversion.

• Lifecycle marketing: Partner with CRM teams to develop onboarding, engagement, cross-sell, replenishment, and reactivation programs.

• Product ecosystem growth: Develop programs that encourage first purchase, adoption of complementary products, and continued participation in the brand’s ecosystem.

• Testing and experimentation: Manage a prioritized testing roadmap across audiences, messaging, offers, channels, and consumer experiences.

• Retail and commerce integration: Coordinate growth initiatives with sales and e-commerce teams to support retailer traffic, conversion, and sell-through.

• Performance analysis: Monitor results, identify growth opportunities, and recommend where to expand, adjust, or discontinue investment.

• Cross-functional execution: Manage project timelines, dependencies, and accountability across internal teams and external partners.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Five or more years of experience in growth marketing, digital marketing, e-commerce, or consumer lifecycle management.

• Demonstrated success improving acquisition, conversion, retention, or customer lifetime value.

• Experience working across paid media, CRM, content, and commerce channels.

• Strong analytical skills and familiarity with web analytics, CRM platforms, and performance dashboards.

• Working knowledge of consumer segmentation, customer journeys, and structured experimentation.

• Ability to translate insights into actionable programs and manage multiple initiatives.

• Strong collaboration, communication, and project management skills.

• Consumer brand, retail, e-commerce, or durable goods experience preferred.

Success Measures

• New consumer acquisition and acquisition efficiency.

• Conversion rate improvements.

• Incremental revenue and contribution to profitable growth.

• Repeat purchase rate and customer retention.

• Cross-category purchasing and product ecosystem expansion.

• Customer lifetime value.

• Growth of engaged, identifiable first-party audiences.

• Measurable business impact from testing and optimization.

description:
Job Description:

The Process Technician supports the injection molding operation by assisting with machine setups, monitoring production processes, and helping ensure the consistent manufacture of high-quality plastic components. You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Consistently demonstrates safety first mindset; follows all safety related processes and procedures, quickly escalates safety related concerns or issues to create a safe work environment for all employees.

• Complete injection molds and related equipment startup, shutdown, and basic setup activities for sample/production runs.

• Monitor molding machine gauges, pressures, temperatures and production processes to ensure parts meet quality standards.

• Perform routine process checks and document production data including cycle times and part quality.

• Work unsupervised while using manual and/or power equipment and tools while performing multiple tasks.

• Assist in mold changes and material changes as directed.

• Identify and report quality concerns, equipment issues, or process deviations.

• Make process adjustments to maintain product quality.

• Support troubleshooting efforts for molding defects and equipment issues to correct problem processes.

• Manage the collection and movement of recyclable materials to designated holding areas in support of efficient plant operations.

• Maintain process documentation and production records.

• Follow standardized work instructions and operating procedures.

• Maintain work area, including but not limited to, mold storage, secondary equipment storage and mold crib, per 6s facility standards without direction to reduce scrap and improve manufacturing efficiency.

• Proactively work with team members to meet the needs of the production floor.

• Ability to work overtime with advanced or little notice.

• All other duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• High School Diploma or GED

• Moderate proficiency to read and communicate in English

• 2+ years of specified Molding Technician experience

• 2+ years of quality and/or troubleshooting experience in a Molding environment

• Knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics, robotics, and electronics.

• Forklift Certification (Milwaukee will train)

• Speed, Agility & Urgency- Quickly respond to changing priorities, production demands, and equipment issues to support scheduled production requirements while maintaining multiple tasks simultaneously with safety and quality standards.

• User Focused, Solution Driven- Maintain a strong attention to detail and accuracy to ensure equipment performs at the highest level of efficiency to produce quality products for a positive end user experience.

• Extreme Ownership- Demonstrates accountability for machine performance, product quality, safety, and work area organization by proactively identifying issues, taking action to resolve them, and seeing tasks through to completion.

• One Team Mentality- Maintain excellent attendance and punctuality, supporting smooth operations and team success

• Disruptive Mindset- Bring positive energy that motivates others while working independently or alongside a team

• Candid- Support a culture of transparency and accountability across the department through honest, direct feedback

• Relentless Improvement- The initiative to identify opportunities for process improvement, raising the standard for yourself and your team.

Working Conditions:

• The employee may be required to frequently lift, carry, push or pull up to 35 pounds

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

• Prolonged standing and/or walking for up to 12 hours per shift

• Physically demanding that requires frequent bending, crouching, twisting, and reaching

• Regular exposure to a greasy manufacturing environment is expected

• Employees are required to wear the proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in certain work cells
