title: Tool Integration Electrical Engineer I/II
description:
Job Description:

Techtronic Industries is a fast-growing world leader in Power Tools, Outdoor Power Equipment, Accessories, and Hand Tools. The Company is committed to accelerating the transformation of these industries through superior environmentally friendly cordless technology. At TTi Anderson, our RYOBI and RIDGID brands are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and cordless product platforms of superior quality, outstanding performance, safety, productivity, and compelling innovation.

The Tool Integration Electrical Engineer I/II will drive the embedded systems design and implementation for battery-powered outdoor equipment, with a focus on power electronics, motor control, sensors, switches, harnesses, and connectors. You will work through the product development process in a team environment interacting with cross-functional stakeholders such as hardware, firmware, product development, and test engineers. This position will sit onsite at our headquarters in Anderson, South Carolina.

Primary Job Functions:

• Under supervision of senior engineers, execute hardware systems development for new cordless tools, including the design of PCBA hardware and wiring, and the selection of switches, connectors and electronic components.

• Support prototype assembly, troubleshooting, and demonstration to cross-functional team members.

• Modify and expand upon existing embedded firmware as needed for new product offerings.

• Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, ESD testers, and data acquisition systems to debug and develop your designs.

• Conduct experiments, perform simulations, and draw concise, logical conclusions by analyzing data.

• Work with other engineers to create and amend test plans for new product categories.

• Work with cross-functional teams for trade-off discussions related to new product development.

• Demonstrate high performance and agility by independently creating Work Breakdown Structures for your work, driving to critical milestones, and communicating candidly up and down the organization on project progress and risk mitigation.

• With support from the Regulatory team, ensure new product designs are compliant with applicable regulatory standards such as UL, TÜV, CEC, CE, CPSC, and ANSI.

Required Job Qualifications:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.

• 0.5 to 4 years of experience in embedded electronics design with strong hardware skills, including 32-bit microcontroller-based circuits (exposure to firmware, power electronics, EMI/EMC, and harness design is a plus). Relevant internships, co-ops, research, and even hobbies may be factored into overall experience.

• Experience with engineering design tools such as PCBA schematic/layout and circuit simulation software. Familiarity with embedded C development tools (IDEs, compilers, debuggers) is a big plus.

• Understanding of battery-powered tool architecture and circuits as well as related troubleshooting and validation of circuit changes.

• Knowledge of electronic component selection and design tradeoffs.

• Ability to scrutinize designs for optimization, continuous improvement and cost reduction opportunities.

• Excellent problem-solving and multi-tasking skills, ability to exercise independent judgment and work well under pressure in a dynamic environment.

• Proven ability to create a Work Breakdown Structure, drive projects to completion, communicate progress, and escalate roadblocks to management when needed.

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, including domestic and international, specifically Vietnam.

title: Sr. Systems Reliability Engineer
description:
Job Description:

The Sr. Systems Reliability Engineer will provide technical leadership in the development, validation, and reliability of complex product systems that integrate electrical hardware, embedded firmware, software, communications, and connected technologies.

This role will apply a combination of system, reliability, and test engineering skills to identify and mitigate reliability risks across platform architectures, with particular emphasis on electrical design and hardware-firmware-software interfaces. The Sr. Systems Reliability Engineer will work cross-functionally with Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Software, Systems Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, Product, and Service teams to ensure system requirements, interfaces, failure modes, and reliability expectations are understood and validated throughout the product development lifecycle.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

Systems Reliability & Product Development

• Lead cross-functional reliability efforts for new platform reference designs and engineering changes, translating user requirements, field performance, and warranty insights into actionable system reliability requirements and design improvements.

• Collaborate with Engineering and Product/Marketing teams to establish to translate user needs into measurable Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) interface and system reliability targets that reflect intended use, environmental conditions, system interactions, Service needs, and customer expectations.

• Evaluate critical interfaces between electrical hardware, embedded firmware, software, communications, and external systems to identify potential integration and system-level reliability risks.

• Lead system and design risk assessments, including DFMEA, interface risk analysis, fault propagation analysis, and other system-level reliability assessments throughout the product development lifecycle.

• Support Advanced Engineering activities targeting high-risk technologies, architectures, interfaces, and CTQs.

• Provide candid and effective communications up, down and across the organization on progress, barrier removal, and escalations of business risks/opportunities.

System Verification, Validation & Reliability Testing

• Lead the development of risk-based system verification and validation strategies spanning interfaces, products, and systems.

• Develop test plans and procedures that demonstrate products and integrated systems meet reliability targets, Service targets, and end user needs.

• Collaborate with test laboratories and cross-functional engineering teams on execution of system-level reliability and validation plans.

• Analyze test and field data using appropriate statistical techniques including Weibull analysis, life-data analysis, reliability distributions, and Design of Experiments.

• Draw clear, technically defensible conclusions from testing and communicate risks, and recommendations to engineering and business stakeholders.

Failure Analysis & Continuous Improvement

• Lead system-level root-cause investigations involving complex system interactions

• Lead Failure Reporting, Analysis, and Corrective Action (FRACA) activities and ensure corrective actions address underlying system failure mechanisms.

• Translate Service, Field Quality, and warranty learnings into design requirements, reliability models, test methods, and future product improvements.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (Electrical, Computer, Systems, or a related engineering discipline)

• 5+ years of relevant experience in product development, systems engineering, electrical engineering, embedded systems, reliability engineering, or system validation.

• Experience applying reliability principles to complex electromechanical and/or embedded systems.

• Working knowledge of electrical and electronic system design, including the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, component datasheets, and system architecture diagrams.

• Knowledge of embedded firmware architectures and hardware-firmware interfaces, including sensors, actuators, communication interfaces, memory, timing, power states, and fault handling.

• Experience leading technical risk assessments including DFMEA and other structured reliability/risk-analysis methods.

• Experience developing and executing system verification and validation

• Experience with Design of Experiments, life-data analysis, Weibull analysis, and related statistical reliability techniques and tools.

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical investigations and drive problems to root cause across multiple engineering disciplines.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Demonstrated technical knowledge and ability to influence engineering decisions across cross-functional teams.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10%.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related discipline.

• Experience with requirements management and system engineering methods.

• Experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C, BLE, Wi-Fi, or similar technologies.

• ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) certification or willingness to achieve certification.

• Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) or Six Sigma experience.

title: Molding Materials Coordinator
description:
Job Description:

Your Role on Our Team

At Milwaukee Tool, we are committed to delivering high-quality, innovative solutions to our users. The Molding Material Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the uninterrupted flow of materials to all molding production areas. This role supports manufacturing operations by monitoring material consumption, maintaining inventory accuracy, coordinating material movement, and ensuring molding machines have the required resin, colorants, and supporting materials available throughout the shift. The Molding Material Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting safety, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives within the molding department.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Consistently demonstrates safety first mindset; follows all safety related processes and procedures, quickly escalates safety related concerns or issues to create a safe work environment for all employees.

• Ensure molding machines are stocked with the appropriate materials required to maintain production schedules.

• Review daily production schedules and coordinate material requirements for current and upcoming shifts.

• Transport raw materials, resin, colorants, and packaging supplies to designated production areas.

• Load dryers according to established material specifications and drying requirements.

• Monitor dryer performance and material readiness to support production demand.

• Empty, clean, and prepare dryers during material changeovers to prevent contamination.

• Conduct routine material level audits and replenish materials as needed throughout the molding facility.

• Maintain accurate inventory records through physical counts and inventory transactions.

• Perform cycle counts and physical inventories of resins, colorants, and related molding materials.

• Support material traceability requirements and ensure proper labeling and identification of all materials.

• Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment safely and effectively.

• Coordinate with Process Technicians, Production Supervisors, and Team Leaders to ensure material availability and resolve shortages.

• Follow First-In-First-Out (FIFO) inventory practices and established material handling procedures.

• Support production changeovers by staging materials and removing obsolete materials from work areas.

• Maintain organized storage areas and support 5S initiatives within the molding department.

• Identify and communicate inventory discrepancies, material quality concerns, or supply risks.

•  Assist with training and cross-functional support for other indirect labor positions as needed.

• Maintain work area, including but not limited to, mold storage, secondary equipment storage and mold crib, per 6s facility standards without direction.

• Adhere to all company safety, quality, environmental, and operational policies.

• Proactively work with team members to meet the needs of the production floor.

• Ability to work overtime with advanced or little notice.

• All other duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• High School Diploma or GED

• 1 year of molding experience

• Forklift certification (TTI will train)

• Extreme attention to detail

• Experience with excel/reading schedules

• Exposure to Kanban and 5s concepts

• Previous experience as material handler

• Safety conscious

• Speed, Agility & Urgency- Quickly respond to changing priorities, production demands, and equipment issues to support scheduled production requirements while maintaining multiple tasks simultaneously with safety and quality standards.

• User Focused, Solution Driven- Maintain a strong attention to detail and accuracy to ensure equipment performs at the highest level of efficiency to produce quality products for a positive end user experience.

• Extreme Ownership- Takes full accountability for safety, quality, productivity, and equipment readiness by proactively identifying and resolving issues, following through on commitments, and taking initiative to ensure mold set-ups, tooling changes, and production support activities are completed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.

• One Team Mentality- Maintain excellent attendance and punctuality, supporting smooth operations and team success

• Disruptive Mindset- Bring positive energy that motivates others while working independently or alongside a team

• Candid- Support a culture of transparency and accountability across the department through honest, direct feedback

• Relentless Improvement- The initiative to identify opportunities for process improvement, raising the standard for yourself and your team.

Working Conditions:

• The employee may be required to frequently lift, carry, push or pull up to 35 pounds

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

• Prolonged standing and/or walking for up to 12 hours per shift

• Ability to work in a non-climate-controlled environment

• Frequent bending, crouching, twisting, reaching

• Comfortable working at heights up to 30 feet using lifts, such as man-ups, to access inventory

• Employees are required to wear the proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as intended

description:
Job Description:

Company Engineering Overview:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! - At Milwaukee Tool, we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success. Our Engineering teams are key contributors to continuous innovation, delivering disruptive technologies through direct engagement with end users and cross-functional collaboration. We create best-in-class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Dept Engineering Overview:

Create test solutions for Tomorrow’s Tools. At Milwaukee Tool, disruptive innovation extends beyond the products we bring to market. As a member of the Test Automation Group (TAG), you will develop innovative automated test systems that support new product development across North America and our global laboratories. You will work cross-functionally with New Product Development, Reliability, Quality, and Laboratory teams to define requirements, develop solutions, and drive automation projects from concept through deployment.

The Automation Engineer II is a capable technical contributor who develops automated test solutions with growing ownership and independence. This individual applies knowledge of TAG, Lab, and NPD processes to make sound design decisions, recognizes project schedule and design risks early, and proactively communicates obstacles with potential solutions. They collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global partners, receive design feedback constructively, begin providing relevant design guidance to others, and continue building technical depth, project execution capability, and productive team relationships.

Be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

Overall:

• Develop automated test systems to support new product development, with growing ownership of project scope, requirements, design, build, integration, and deployment activities.

• Support project scope discussions and system requirements development in collaboration with New Product Development, Test Lab, Reliability Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Interpret project charters and leverage project objectives to support engineering decisions.

• Create and maintain system documentation including BOMs, operating instructions, risk assessments, validation documentation, and design review materials.

• Partner with vendors for system procurement, technical collaboration, costing, and schedule management.

• Analyze project risks and communicate concerns related to cost, schedule, procurement, design maturity, quality, and safety.

• Proactively escalate project obstacles and roadblocks while bringing potential solutions and mitigation options to stakeholders.

• Prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, communication, and execution discipline.

• Apply structured problem-solving and root cause analysis methods to troubleshoot issues and evaluate alternative solutions.

• Demonstrate ownership of project success through proactive communication, risk awareness, follow-through, and data-supported recommendations.

• Enhance technical competency and skills by seeking growth opportunities that improve individual efficiency and project execution.

Controls Programming:

• Create and maintain custom software

• Create and query SQL databases to save test data, create data visualizations, and enable data-driven decisions.

• Implement sensor technology, data acquisition, and motion control.

• Design electrical panel wiring and layout for automated test systems.

• Integrate and troubleshoot physical hardware, sensors, measurement devices, safety systems, and motion devices across domestic and global test labs.

Technical Collaboration and Project Ownership

• Serve as a dependable technical contributor on medium-complexity automation projects.

• Drive assigned project work with minimal guidance while maintaining alignment with project scope, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.

• Provide constructive design feedback and technical guidance to peers during design reviews and project discussions.

• Collaborate with teams internally and cross-functionally to solve problems.

• Communicate project status, technical risks, design tradeoffs, and recommended next steps clearly to stakeholders.

• Use TAG, laboratory, and NPD processes to support project execution, design maturity, and validation planning.

• Contribute to engineering best practices, design standards, documentation templates, and automation methodologies.

• Support a culture of continuous learning, accountability, innovation, and technical excellence.

What SUCCESS looks like:

A successful Automation Engineer II:

• Independently drives automation projects from concept through deployment while balancing scope, quality, schedule, and cost.

• Proactively identifies risks, communicates roadblocks early, and brings data-supported solutions to stakeholders.

• Builds strong relationships across Product Engineering, Reliability, Laboratory, Vendor, and Global teams to achieve project objectives.

• Applies sound engineering judgment and structured problem-solving to deliver robust, innovative test solutions.

• Continuously improves technical capabilities, engineering processes, and team effectiveness while growing as a technical leader.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

Overall:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering or related engineering discipline.

• 2+ years of experience developing automated systems, industrial equipment, test systems, or complex engineering solutions.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and engineering problem-solving abilities.

• Hands-on experience integrating, commissioning, and debugging industrial systems.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects or technical assignments with limited supervision.

• Ability to assess technical options and provide sound recommendations based on data, project scope, cost, schedule, safety, and long-term maintainability.

• Strong written, verbal, presentation, and technical communication skills.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and global laboratory teams.

• Willingness to travel internationally, less than 10%.

Controls Programming:

• Experience with mechatronic system software development using languages such as LabVIEW, Python, C#.

• Knowledge of test and measurement techniques, including sensor technology, signal conditioning, data acquisition (utilizing NI cDAQ, NI cRIO, and PLCs), and uncertainty calculations.

• Familiarity with SQL database design, SQL queries, Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks.

• Experience using software source control (GIT preferred).

• Experience creating and interpreting electrical schematics (SolidWorks Electrical preferred).

title: Design Researcher II
description:
Design Researcher II
Job Description:

Design Researcher II

The Design Research team at Milwaukee Tool sits within a collaborative user-centered design and technology development group focused on the fuzzy front end of product development. We are tasked with informing the entrepreneurial spirit of the company, influencing and inspiring the direction of the business through strategic and functional findings. In this role you will be leading the research efforts of highly collaborative and diverse teams of Engineers, Industrial Designers, and Product Managers to inspire and influence key decision makers on new solutions for the construction industry.

You must be permanently eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship for this position.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Design and execute multi-faceted research plans to learn about all aspects of the construction trade. These plans typically include qualitative discovery research on jobsites, primary and secondary research exercises to understand the competitive product set, and evaluation of mock-ups and preliminary concept prototypes in field.

• Build, grow, and maintain a network of users to understand their evolving needs and work context. Establishing strong relationships with our end users is critical to conducting appropriate discovery research, co-creating solutions, and eliciting honest feedback.

• Analyze and synthesize research findings into key insights that inform opportunities for new feature sets, functionalities, and business approaches.

• Plan and facilitate hands-on tool evaluations, team workshops, and analysis sessions. These participatory co-creation sessions result in a common ground of familiarity with a tool and its use, while inspiring creativity and collaboration within your team.

• Present research findings in an engaging and concise manner to key stakeholders across the business. You will need to communicate through well-crafted presentations and events that educate and inspire your team through photos, video, diagrams, storytelling and demonstrations.

• Experiment with new approaches and methodologies to achieve ingenious results. As a research group we encourage new ways of thinking, and we want you to help us build new tools and methodologies appropriate to the work we do.

Required Skills:

• You thrive when approaching potential research participants (e.g., on a construction site) to introduce yourself and engage in observation and open-ended lines of questioning

• You are curious, not just about your research topic but also the company, your co-workers, and your process

• You are ready to jump in with both feet to try new methods and learn from your mistakes

description:
Job Description:

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay for this position is $27.41/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $57,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs/ Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 9 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at https://www.ttigroup.com/careers/us.

title: Quality/Reliability Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization, that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with end users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create best in class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

Reporting to the Quality Manager, works from broad guidelines and objectives. provides quality engineering services to cross-functional project teams which include New Product Development, Product Support, and Value Engineering. Project team members are led by a Project Leader and include Engineering, Marketing, Purchasing, Quality, and Manufacturing. Primary duties are to lead and direct the advanced quality and reliability activities of project teams to successfully meet Project Quality/Reliability Objectives as well as project goals including Supplier Development, Time-To-Market, Cost, and Performance. The primary duty of this position is to serve as a Quality & Reliability expert to the business and projects teams, with moderate supervision.  Should be able to demonstrate strong problem-solving & critical thinking skills and show proactiveness in executing deliverables.

Quality Engineering Responsibilities (60%)

• Work with the global quality teams to develop QC mitigation strategies for high-risk specifications.

• Coordinate quality planning activities such as auditing, inspection, and control plans (incoming, in-process and outgoing) that drive user need CtQ requirements through product specifications and into manufacturing processes.

• Collaborate with US, European, and Asian-based manufacturing and supplier representatives to ensure operational readiness of new product launches

• Ensure manufacturing process stability and capability through the use of advanced statistical methods; including Six Sigma methods, and Ppk and Cpk analysis and interpretation

• Use advanced statistical analysis to recommend process improvements and value engineering ideas

• Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers.

• Able to call, lead and conduct global, cross-functional team members with the following participants: New product development engineering, internal/external operations/suppliers, quality, and supply chain.

• Provide technical guidance to the PRC and US-based supplier quality teams.

• Identify and work on process improvement opportunities within the Quality/Reliability Department, beyond the core project teams.

• Monitor, investigate, and report field product reviews, utilizing various user feedback data streams to determine overall product health and assess risk of product quality.

Reliability Engineering Responsibilities (40%)

• Collaborate with Engineering and Marketing to translate customer needs into product requirements and specifications.

• Support the product design process including benchmarking and testing of concepts & prototypes.

• Develop and execute test procedures to validate product specifications and ensure Quality and Reliability readiness.

• Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle.

• Perform reliability analysis, using advanced statistical techniques including Weibull, ANOVA, and other statistical tools.

• Interpret and present advanced statistical data to a cross-functional team in a concise format.

• Perform failure analysis, and recommend solutions with corrective action, as required.

• Proactively seek out quality improvements for new and existing products.

Education and Experience Requirements

• Bachelor's Degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• 2+ years of related work experience in Advanced Quality, Quality Engineering and/or Reliability Engineering preferred

• Use of advanced statistical methods and techniques in the Reliability and/or Quality disciplines (including Six Sigma methods, Weibull, Linear Regression, etc)

• Extremely critical thinker, able to evaluate and identify risks in the early product development cycle and able drive projects to mitigate those risks.

• Experience in manufacturing environments is highly preferred.

• Ability to travel 20% of the time.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Advanced Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

The Advanced Quality Engineer provides quality engineering services to cross-functional project teams which include New Product Development, Product Support, and Value Engineering. Project team members are led by a Project Leader and include Engineering, Marketing, Purchasing, Quality, and Manufacturing. Teams collaborate both locally and globally. Primary duties are to lead and direct the quality and reliability activities of project teams to successfully meet project objectives and goals including time-to-market, cost, and performance.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Serve as the project team lead for the Quality and Reliability function while supporting process improvement initiatives.

Reliability Functions:

•
Collaborate with Engineering and Marketing to translate customer needs into product requirements and specifications.

•
Support the product design process including benchmarking and testing of concepts & prototypes.

•
Develop and execute test procedures to validate product specifications and ensure Quality and Reliability readiness.

•
Conduct reliability analyses using Weibull, Minitab, and other statistical methods to evaluate product performance and create reliability targets.

•
Lead risk assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle.

•
Lead root cause analyses (5-Whys, Fishbone, etc.) and drive effective corrective and preventive actions.

•
Proactively seek out quality improvements for new and existing products.

Quality Functions:

•
Work with the global quality teams to develop QC mitigation strategies for high risk specifications.

•
Coordinate quality planning activities such as auditing, inspection, and control plans (incoming, in-process and outgoing) that drives user need CtQ requirements through product specifications and into manufacturing processes.

•
Collaborate with US, European, and Asian based manufacturing and supplier representatives to ensure operational readiness of new product launches.

•
Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers.

•
Assess manufacturing and supplier process capability and measurement system stability through gauge studies and capability analyses (PpK, CpK).

•
Able to call, lead and conduct global, cross functional team members with the following participants: New product development engineering, internal/external operations/suppliers, quality and supply chain.

•
Provide technical guidance to the PRC supplier quality team.

•
Organize and present key New Product Development project milestones to cross functional team members and leadership.

Job Requirements:

•
Bachelor’s degree in metallurgical, manufacturing, industrial, mechanical engineering or equivalent.

•
2+ years of related work experience in Advanced Quality, Quality Engineering and/or Reliability Engineering preferred.

•
Exceptional critical thinker, skilled at evaluating and anticipating risks early in product development and leading initiatives to mitigate them.

•
Relevant experience with statistical tools such as Minitab and ReliaSoft.

•
Strong communication and influencing skills across all organizational levels, with proficiency in delivering impactful presentations using PowerPoint.

•
Ability to travel 20% (includes both domestic and international)

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Supply Planner
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Supply Planner that is responsible for maintaining an accurate Production, Sales, and Inventory Plan to support company and customer expectations within acceptable inventory targets.

We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Scope

This position will define inventory targets and purchasing needs to support company sales while exceeding service level and turns targets. Planners work closely with multiple associates across the supply chain to ensure expectations are clearly defined, including:

• Sales managers, product development teams, and demand planners to capture best collaborative forecast

• Factory teams to ensure expectations are clearly defined and that goods ship on time while managing inventory within budget requirements.

• Purchasing to ensure factory purchase orders are aligned to timing needs

• Customers to align retail sales expectations, assist with the containerization of direct flow goods, and address opportunities

• Successfully deliver New Product through the stages of Capacity Evaluation, Ramp Up Production & In Market Delivery

• Coordinate plant transfers between factories

• Maintain reports critical to business function, including financial forecast, inventory projections, and service performance

• Facilitate Global Capacity Planning to deliver aggressive 98% SL, and assess capacity expansion needs

Associate Industrial Designer

Position Overview:

Milwaukee Tool is seeking a creative, talented, and driven Associate Industrial Designer to support our Fastening category.

• Operate and maintain a wide range of tools and equipment including forklifts, scissor lifts, power tools, and hand tools.

• Operate and maintain cleaning equipment such as floor scrubbers, drain cleanout equipment, and related systems.

• Utilize the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to document maintenance activities, manage work orders, and track inventory and MRO parts.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives, including 6S, lean manufacturing, and energy efficiency projects.

• Perform routine building inspections and execute preventive and corrective maintenance to address facility-related issues promptly including rack/structural repair and replacement.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support equipment installations, upgrades, relocations, and layout changes.

• Prioritize tasks effectively while maintaining compliance with budgetary constraints and operational requirements.

• Escorts, monitors, and aid service vendors to ensure service level visibility.

• Support operations in Emergency Response situations, ensuring clear and concise direction and communication to ensure safety of associates and efficiency of operations.

Performs other duties as assigned.

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• 3+ years of maintenance experience

• Ability to adapt to evolving technologies and solve unexpected mechanical or software issues

• Engineering or Automation Degree or related certifications

• Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)

• Experience with automated equipment

• Experience with programmable logic controllers (PLCs), HMIs, robot controllers, and automated logic

• Experience assisting with installation, configuration, and deployment of automated equipment

• OSHA safety training certifications

• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, manuals, and technical drawings

Production

title: Prototype Machinist
description:
Job Description:

The Prototype Machinist is an entry-level position responsible for learning and developing machining skills while assisting in the fabrication of prototype components, fixtures, gauges, tooling, and other machine parts. Under the guidance of experienced machinists and prototype shop personnel, the machinist will gain hands-on experience operating machine shop equipment, interpreting engineering drawings, performing basic machining operations, and supporting prototype development activities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
•Learn and follow all company safety policies, procedures, and shop practices.
•Assist in the setup and operation of manual and CNC machine tools under supervision.
•Support the fabrication of prototype parts, fixtures, gauges, tooling, and related components from drawings, sketches, CAD models, and verbal instructions.
•Perform basic machining tasks including drilling, milling, turning, sawing, tapping, and other operations as assigned.
•Complete secondary operations such as deburring, sanding, polishing, assembly, and part finishing.
•Learn to use precision measuring instruments including calipers, micrometers, indicators, height gauges, and other inspection tools.
•Assist with preventive maintenance, cleaning, lubrication, and upkeep of prototype shop equipment.
•Support Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing teams on prototype and development projects.
•Learn to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and basic GD&T requirements.
•Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
•Participate in training and skill development activities to increase machining knowledge and technical capabilities.
•Perform other duties assigned to support prototype shop objectives.
Physical and Environmental Requirements
•Ability to stand for extended periods while operating machinery and performing shop tasks.
•Ability to work in a machine shop environment with exposure to noise, dust, and manufacturing equipment.
•Ability to safely use hand tools, measuring equipment, and shop machinery.
•Ability to lift, carry, and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
•Ability to use a personal computer and related software applications.

Qualifications
•High school diploma or GED required.
•Enrollment in or completion of a technical program in Machine Tool Technology, Manufacturing Technology, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred.
•Previous coursework, vocational training, internships, co-op experience, or hands-on machining experience is a plus but not required.
•Basic mechanical aptitude and interest in machining, manufacturing, and prototype development.
•Ability to learn machining fundamentals, blueprint reading, measurement techniques, and shop practices.
•Strong mathematical skills and problem-solving ability.
•Ability to follow instructions and accept coaching from experienced team members.
•Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
•Strong work ethic, dependability, punctuality, and attendance.
•Desire to learn new skills and grow within the machining profession.
•Ability to work effectively with coworkers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams.
•Commitment to following all company policies, procedures, and safety requirements.

Career Development Opportunities
This position provides hands-on training in:
•Manual machining (mills, lathes, grinders, and related equipment)
•CNC machine setup and operation
•Blueprint reading and GD&T fundamentals
•Precision measurement and inspection methods
•Fixture and tooling fabrication
•Waterjet machining
•CAD/CAM fundamentals
•Prototype manufacturing processes
•Troubleshooting and problem-solving techniques
•Welding Tig/Mig/Stick when needed

title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative- Miami, FL (Coconut Grove)
description:
Job Description:

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provides TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Hart ®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this position, you will drive sales of our premier product lines within one of our largest retail partners. This position will allow you to enhance your selling, account management, and communication skills while launching your career in a fast-paced and extremely rewarding company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies)

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $27.41/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $57,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holidays (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

description:
Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. ·          Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

·          Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

description:

*Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position.

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you access to everything you need to define and support technical solutions within our IT team to enable business value.

Our IT team is responsible for supporting our continued growth by partnering with each function to align the IT strategy and identify solutions; automating business processes; developing custom software solutions; providing and governing access to data; evaluating and implementing purchased software solutions; enabling advanced technologies like Cloud Applications, AI and ML; and supporting the infrastructure and security these solutions require across the enterprise. We work to solve business challenges and drive efficiency through technology.

Your Role on Our Team

As an IT Advisor II - you will serve as a technology partner to different areas of the business,. This role will be engaged in delivering and supporting the technologies, processes, integrations, and solutions that support our custom development and enterprise platforms.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will contribute to the definition, development, delivery, and support of systems and solutions, ensuring seamless data flow and efficient operations. Your ability to organize thoughts, execute tasks, and create and execute test plans will be essential in delivering high-quality IT solutions.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Drive the identification and definition of business requirements working with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Build relationships with stakeholders to understand their processes, pain points, and opportunities.

• Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams to define and develop solutions supporting product data management including process improvements to drive efficiency and system integrations and automation.

• Serve as a communications liaison between Solution Delivery and stakeholders to understand key issues, identify perception gaps, and resolve questions.

• Apply Agile methodologies to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and sprint reviews to deliver IT solutions in iterative cycles.

• Support issue, idea, and initiative intake and backlog to support work estimation, prioritization, and planning.

• Drive initiative execution by removing blockers and providing clear status updates to cross-functional stakeholders.

• Build experience with key business processes and align industry best practices to support solution design and development.

• Expand data extraction and analysis to drive insights and identify issues and opportunities for alignment. Utilize data extraction, analysis, and transformation techniques to validate data quality and drive alignment.

• Create and maintain detailed documentation of IT solutions, integrations, and test plans to facilitate knowledge sharing and seamless handovers.

• Coordinate the identification, documentation, and execution of test scenarios to validate solution delivery.

• Support the resolution of open incidents with a focus on Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and solution support and troubleshooting.

The TOOLS you'll bring with you:

• Bachelor’s degree in management information systems or in a relevant field study such as Digital Marketing, Business, IT, Supply Chain etc. or relevant work experience with an emphasis in technology.

• 3+ years of experience as a business analyst, product owner, or in a technical role working with technical teams and business stakeholders.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence and organize.

• Ability to breakdown strategic objectives into actionable work for development teams.

• Proficiency in business analysis methodologies and tools.

• Experience with business applications, processes, and solution implementation methodologies.

• Strong functional analysis skills to drive business requirement definition that involves eliciting, analyzing, prioritizing, articulating, and documenting business requirements.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to summarize and communicate effectively across functional audiences and topics while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Experience with project management knowledge areas including planning, scheduling, and execution. Ability to lead multiple small to medium projects with guidance.

• Strong SQL and data analysis skills.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Experience in program governance using both waterfall and agile methodologies combined with demonstrated ability to manage large, complex projects.

• Background in collaborating with custom development teams.

• ITIL or other technical certifications.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on business value and strategic alignment.

• Continuous improvement mindset with a willingness to challenge existing processes and identify better ways of working.

title: CI Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

INNOVATE without boundaries! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success.

We are an inclusive workplace that encourages diversity of thought, experience, and background to solve complex problems as one team. Every employee is encouraged to continuously improve and grow, and it is a top priority for managers to develop their teams, making a wide range of internal development opportunities available to all employees.

We are One Team, overcoming obstacles together and celebrating together. Come be part of a winning team that feels like family.

Your Role on Our Team:

The CI Engineer II is responsible for improving manufacturing productivity, capacity, material flow, labor utilization, ergonomics, and overall operational efficiency within the manufacturing facility.

This role partners closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, develop solutions, and implement sustainable improvements. The CI Engineer II uses data analysis, time studies, facility and equipment layouts, standard work, Lean Manufacturing principles, and structured problem-solving methods to optimize manufacturing operations.

This position is highly connected to the production floor and requires an individual who can translate operational challenges into practical, data-driven solutions that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Own and maintain manufacturing routings and Bills of Material (BOMs), ensuring labor standards, work centers, operation sequences, component usage, and other manufacturing master data remain accurate and aligned with current production processes.

• Analyze manufacturing processes to identify constraints, waste, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.

• Perform time studies, work measurement, labor utilization studies, and process observations to establish and maintain accurate manufacturing standards.

• Recommend equipment, labor, shift, and process change necessary to support manufacturing demand.

• Support facility and equipment moves, including equipment installations, relocations, commissioning, transfers, and decommissioning.

• Support New Product Development and manufacturing launches through capacity analysis, line balancing, labor planning, layout development, and manufacturing readiness.

• Maintain accurate labor standards in accordance with established documentation and change-control procedures.

• Improve work methods through the application of Lean Manufacturing techniques and deploy best practices across manufacturing operations.

• Lead or participate in structured root-cause problem solving using tools such as 5 Why, fishbone analysis, Pareto analysis, process mapping, and statistical analysis.

• Support information and technology system deployments and collaborate cross-functionally to successfully execute projects.

• Provide Operations with technical support and guidance to improve resource utilization, productivity, and cost performance.

• Perform data analysis and develop manufacturing metrics, reports, and other tools to support data-driven decision-making.

• Utilize CAD software to develop and improve equipment, workstation, and facility layouts to optimize space utilization and manufacturing flow.

• Utilize simulation and modeling software to evaluate and improve product flow, capacity, resource utilization, and manufacturing performance.

• Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Finance, and EHS to implement sustainable improvements.

• Clearly communicate analysis, recommendations, project status, risks, and financial impact to manufacturing and engineering leadership.

• Provide hands-on support to manufacturing operations as business needs require.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

• Experience in manufacturing, industrial engineering, continuous improvement, or related environment. Level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated capability.

• Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, time studies, labor standards, capacity analysis, and continuous improvement principles.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and drive improvements.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and familiarity with CAD or manufacturing layout tools.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional teams.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent continuous improvement training.

• Understanding knowledge of Kaizen events. Experience with creating value-stream mapping and structured problem-solving activities.

• Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, NX, or similar CAD/layout software.

• Experience with Power BI or comparable data visualization tools.

• Experience with ERP/MRP.

• Experience within a high-volume manufacturing environment.

• Experience supporting capital equipment and automation projects.

• Working knowledge of Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

• Knowledge of engineered labor-standard/time-study methodologies.

• Experience with statistical analysis, process capability, and data-driven decision-making.

• Experience developing business cases for capital, productivity, labor, or capacity improvements.

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

• The employee may be required to frequently lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds.

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

• Prolonged standing of eight or more hours a day.

• Frequent walking.

• Occasional bending, crouching, twisting, and reaching.

• Employees may be required to wear the proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in certain work cells.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Medical, dental and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401(K) savings plan.

• Employee Assistance Programs (EAP).

• Education assistance.

description:
Job Description:

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Job Description:

Design Engineer II – Power Tools Value Engineering

As a Design Engineer II on the Value Engineering Team, you will utilize your developed mechanical engineering skillset to lead cost down initiatives across all Power Tool categories to increase profitability.
